established_points: later backtests with the same configuration can find trained models and load them instead of retraining
changing the FreqAI identifier requests/selects different model state
saved backtest models can be reused for live deployment
FreqAI pipelines may wrap scikit-learn transformation steps
documented examples include QuantileTransformer and StandardScaler
feature and label pipelines are persisted through the producer path above

bounded_conclusion: FreqAI has an intentional cross-execution persisted-object producer/consumer path in which scikit-learn-owned state can participate.
claim_limits: not every FreqAI model is a scikit-learn model
not every persisted pipeline necessarily contains scikit-learn state
this record does not establish failure under scikit-learn 1.8.0
